text:
maya: quick follow-up from last night's page — thanks to everyone who jumped in. we mitigated by rerouting EU traffic at 03:42 UTC and rolling back the config push. filing this thread to coordinate a postmortem, runbook updates, and on-call playbook changes. incident id INC-2026-0423 <https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2026-0423>

ben: +1. initial customer impact estimate: ~15% 5xx rate for hosted-api.eu for ~45m, ~1300 requests failed. CS notified customers flagged as impacted. we should surface the cost/regression metrics in the PM.

aj: i can own runbook edits. rough plan: add a clear checklist for regional config rollbacks, add the exact command snippets we ran, and a short decision tree for when to failover.

maya: awesome. aj, please also add a short test for the rollback step (smoke test) and how to validate KV cache warmup after failover.

sasha: i'll take playbook updates — specifically the escalation chain and on-call handoff wording. current ambiguity: after a P1 is acknowledged, who phones CS? Ops or coverage? we need it explicit.

oncall-bot: created follow-up ticket RW-4321 in "infra-incident-improvements" and added this thread: <https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RW-4321>

ops-analyst: i've uploaded the initial error-rate graph and request sample to the incident artifacts: <https://internal.redwood/incs/INC-2026-0423/artifacts>

ben: timeline notes (quick):
- 02:57 UTC: deploy of routing-config v3 pushed to eu-edge
- 03:04 UTC: alerts spike (5xx rate) — first page
- 03:10 — 03:40: mitigation attempts (partial rollbacks, cache clears)
- 03:42: full rollback to routing-config v2 and traffic rerouted
- 04:15: metrics back to baseline

maya: good timeline. agenda for postmortem meeting:
1) impact & detection (logs, alerts, customer reports)
2) root cause hypothesis & experiment notes
3) remediation steps taken
4) runbook + playbook changes we need
5) action owner + deadlines

aj: propose postmortem slot: Tue 2026-05-05 16:00 UTC (60m). i'll invite infra-sre, eng-runtime, product owner, and a CS rep.

sasha: that works for me. can we also have an async doc ready before the meeting? i'll draft the playbook diffs so people can review.

maya: yes please. owners & responsibilities (draft):
- runbook edits (rollback + smoke tests): aj — due Fri 2026-05-01
- playbook escalation wording + who-calls-customer: sasha — due Mon 2026-05-04
- telemetry dashboards + cost impact calc: ben/ops-analyst — due Thu 2026-04-30
- customer notification audit log: cs-rep (TBD) — due Mon 2026-05-04
- verify alert thresholds (reduce noise): eng-oncall team — due Fri 2026-05-01

ben: assigning a quick query to get exact tokenized cost impact. i'll paste query and results to the RW-4321 ticket.

aj: for runbook, i want the rollback snippet to be explicit. example we ran:
```bash
# rollback routing-config to previous stable
kubectl -n infra set image deploy/eu-edge router=router:v2.14.1
# clear local KV cache (caveat: increases latency for first requests)
redis-cli -h eu-kv-01 FLUSHALL
```
add note: only run flush in maintained maintenance window OR if you confirm no active migrations.

sasha: playbook patch idea (text blurb):
> If P1 impacts hosted API traffic in a single region and persists >10m after first mitigation, escalate to "region-failover" oncall and phone CS lead immediately. If failover executed, open an incident-wide customer-notify ticket.

maya: that's good. we should also add an explicit handoff template for night-to-day oncall that includes: incident summary, actions taken, outstanding items, and where artifacts are stored. sample template below:
```
Handoff template:
- Incident ID: INC-YYYY-NNNN
- Short summary: one-sentence
- Current status: mitigated / ongoing
- Actions taken: list
- Open follow-ups: list + owner + due date
- Links: artifacts, dashboards, runbook PR
```

ops-analyst: one thing we missed in the live incident: we didn't have a quick way to see cross-region cache state. adding a dashboard widget for 'KV cache warmness by region' would speed triage.

aj: i'll add that to runbook's "pre-checks" section: include command to check cache keys count and last-warmed time. sample query for redis:
```text
redis-cli -h eu-kv-01 INFO keyspace | grep db0
```

ben: for action tracking, let's keep things simple: create individual JIRA tasks, tag with incident id, link to RW-4321. assign owners and set SLA 7d for low, 3d for medium, 24h for high.

maya: agreed. final asks before I close thread:
- aj: please post a PR link for runbook changes with a clear diff so reviewers can approve quickly
- sasha: post playbook draft as a gist or doc and tag eng-oncall
- ben/ops-analyst: drop telemetry artifacts into RW-4321
- cs-rep: confirm which customers received notifications and paste the audit

aj: will do. PR target: branch "runbook/rollback-clarify/INC-2026-0423". aiming for PR by Thu EOD.

sasha: draft up in docs now, will ping when ready for reviews.

oncall-bot: reminder set — postmortem meeting invite sent for 2026-05-05 16:00 UTC. follow-up ticket RW-4321 watcher list updated with eng-oncall.

maya: thanks. i'll send meeting pre-read 24h before. if you can't meet the assigned due dates, flag here so we can reassign. :thumbsup:
